description: Version-pinned allowlist of Azure data sources for the Azure Policy / Machine Configuration reporting solution. Not a generic Azure proxy: only entries below may be called, only with the listed method, host, path template and api-version.

placeholders.note: All identifiers in this repository are placeholders. Never commit tenant, subscription or resource identifiers.

allowlistPolicy.rule: Match on method + host + normalized path template + api-version. A GET-only rule is NOT sufficient: POST is permitted only for the entries flagged readOnlyQueryPost.
continuationValidation: nextLink/@odata.nextLink host must be exactly an entry in permittedHosts
scheme must be https and no userinfo/port override
path must match the same path template family as the originating request
subscription/scope in the link must be inside the configured, selected scope
api-version must equal the pinned api-version of the originating entry
credentials are never sent to a link that fails validation
allowlistPolicy.pagingCompleteness: Pagination must be exhausted; a result that cannot be continued is recorded as partial/truncated, never silently complete.

sources.title: Azure Resource Graph query
sources.purpose: Inventory and indexed governance evidence over Resources, PolicyResources, GuestConfigurationResources and ResourceContainers for explicitly selected subscriptions.

body: subscriptions (explicit selected IDs, never implicit whole directory)

rules: replay identical query and scope with returned $skipToken
use stable 'order by id asc' and project a scalar id
do not use limit/take/sample in production collection (prevents continuation)
check mv-expand expansion limits and partition if required
multi-page results are not a transactional snapshot

requiredRbac.scope: selected subscriptions (results are limited by the caller's read access)

sources.notes: ARG is a possibly lagging projection and scrubs PII; it is not authorization evidence for report properties.

sources.title: Policy Insights latest policy states query
sources.apiVersionStatus: unverified-in-this-work-package (carried from plan; confirm in contract spike)
sources.purpose: Latest policy compliance states per resource/assignment/initiative member for a subscription.

rules: follow returned continuation link after host/path/api-version validation
preserve the explicit query window used

requiredRbac.verification: unverified-exact-permission-test-required (Reader must not be assumed to include this action)

sources.notes: Whole-subscription summaries must not be served to a viewer without authorization to every underlying row.

denyList.description: Operations that must never be issued by the application or collector. Enforced by the method/host/path/version allowlist; deny entries document explicit intent and are used in negative tests.

examples.reason: Deployments are never executed as a permission probe; deployments/write is only a capability mapped from Microsoft.Authorization/permissions output.

examples.pathPattern: any host/path not listed in sources[]
examples.reason: No arbitrary URL fetch (including package content URIs), no generic ARM proxy, no raw SQL endpoint.

sinkWrites: logs-ingestion (optional, dedicated reporting resources only, separately approved)
